# cr022-checkbox-linked.xlsx

From `plutext/docx4j`, `docx4j-core-tests/src/test/resources/cr022-checkbox-linked.xlsx` at 0d076bdde:
Excel 365's save of a form-control checkbox linked to a cell, the companion of
`cr022-checkbox.xlsx`. Added whole in CR-004 phase B.
